region_variant: United States / Puerto Rico - eSIM only, NO SIM tray, mmWave variant (the mmWave module is omitted under the antenna exclusion)
pose: +Z up, +X right seen from the front, +Y towards the top of the phone; exported resting at z = 0

textures.detail: every material is a single Principled BSDF with a flat saturated base colour, one colour per material key. There are no image textures, no procedural node trees and no UV maps anywhere in the file; the colours exist to make material assignment readable, not to look photoreal.
textures.uv_maps: none on any of the 191 meshes

material_gaps.severity: SEVERE - the defining conductor of the object
material_gaps.note: There is no titanium key.  Ti-6Al-4V is sigma ~5.8e5 S/m, roughly 60x LESS conductive than `aluminium` (3.5e7) and about half of `stainless` (1.1e6).  `stainless` is the closest of the available keys, still 1.9x too conductive.  Skin depth at 1 GHz: titanium 20.9 um, stainless 15.2 um, aluminium 2.7 um - so using `aluminium` here would be wrong by a factor of 8 in skin depth and would change the surface resistance of the dominant radiating structure by ~8x.  THIS IS THE SINGLE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL GAP IN THE ASSET.

material_gaps.real_material: Apple Ceramic Shield (glass-ceramic with a nanocrystalline phase)
material_gaps.severity: HIGH - the wave enters through it
material_gaps.note: `lens` (eps_r 5.5) is optical glass.  Ceramic Shield is a lithium-aluminosilicate glass-ceramic whose nanocrystalline phase raises the permittivity; published values do not exist. The 0.70 mm sheet in front of the display is the largest dielectric the wave crosses on the front face.

material_gaps.severity: HIGH - the second largest dielectric surface
material_gaps.note: Same class of gap as the front; the etched surface is a sub-micron feature and is not modelled.

material_gaps.real_material: LTPO OLED stack: polyimide substrate, organic layers, thin-film encapsulation, metal cathode
material_gaps.real_eps_r: 3.2-3.5 with a PARTIALLY CONDUCTING cathode (sigma ~1e6 S/m over ~100 nm)
material_gaps.severity: HIGH - a partially conducting sheet modelled as a dielectric
material_gaps.note: No key expresses 'dielectric stack with a thin metal cathode'. Modelled as `pet` with a separate `copper` backplate; the cathode itself is NOT represented.
`steel` is 2.2x too conductive and carries no mu_r at all.  18 magnets plus the alignment magnet.
Nothing in the vocabulary comes close to eps_r 11.7.  The dies are inside closed shield cans, so their contribution is screened; the cans themselves are `stainless`.

material_gaps.part: package moulding compound (A17 Pro, PoP DRAM, NAND)
material_gaps.note: Stated explicitly rather than silently substituted.

material_gaps.real_material: layered Li-ion pouch cell (Cu / graphite / separator / LiCoO2 / Al)
material_gaps.note: `lipo` is one bulk value (eps_r 1.0, sigma 1e5) for a strongly anisotropic layered stack of metal foils.  The real cell is close to a stack of conductors.

material_gaps.real_material: moulded LCP / PC-ABS composite with glass fill

antennas_excluded_per_brief: antenna flexes (main lower antenna flex, upper antenna flex)
mmWave module (A2848 is a US mmWave variant; the module, its radome and its flex are all omitted)
RF coaxial cables and their MHF/U.FL connectors (6 in this device)
diversity antenna elements at the top and bottom
antenna contact springs and their gold pads
kept_deliberately: MagSafe magnet array (18 magnets + alignment magnet) - a magnet is not a radiator
inductive charging coil (12 turns) - a coil is not a radiator
the plastic split lines in the titanium band - these are gaps in a metal band, part of the frame's own moulding, and they are what breaks the frame into five electrically separate segments

sub_millimetre_features.argument: M1.2 thread pitch is 0.25 mm against lambda = 23-300 mm (0.001-0.011 lambda).  Modelled as smooth shanks.
Below 0.015 lambda; the connector shell, which is the conductor boundary that matters, IS modelled.
Trace width ~0.06 mm.  The two continuous ground planes, which carry essentially all the board's scattering, ARE modelled at 1 oz (0.035 mm).
~20 um pitch; the OLED stack is modelled as continuous sheets.

sub_millimetre_features.feature: bottom grille mesh behind the perforations
sub_millimetre_features.argument: ~0.05 mm wire.  The PERFORATIONS themselves are modelled - they are apertures in a conductor.

not_modelled_other: SIM tray - the build is A2848 (US), which is eSIM-only and has no SIM tray; the supplied exterior model likewise has no SIM aperture
individual silicon dies inside the shield cans
battery BMS PCB components (the flex and connector are modelled)
camera VCM/OIS actuator coils and magnets (the barrel, lens stack, sensor and flex are modelled)
